name: Omae no Danna Datte Ore no Tsuma o Ubattan Dakara, Ii Darou? ~Fukushuu no Netori~
original_name: お前の旦那だって俺の妻を奪ったんだから、いいだろう？ ～復讐のネトリ～
source:
The days I thought were happy were all a lie.

"You feel so much better than him...!"
"W-What?!"

One night, Tamiya Muneharu discovers his beloved wife's affair. Moreover, her lover is a man who is also a close friend of his. He is the husband of the Sasatani couple, who live next door to the Tamiyas.

Determined to seek revenge, Muneharu decides that a simple divorce would only bring joy to that unfaithful man. Instead, he sets his sights on the wife of the Sasatani couple.

"No, stop... Let me go!"
"If you must blame someone, blame your despicable husband."

Just wait, Sasatani. I'll make you experience the pain of having something precious taken away!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010280.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
我以为幸福的日子都是谎言。

“你的感觉比他好多了……！”
“什、什么？！”

一天晚上，田宫宗春发现了他心爱的妻子的外遇。而且，她的爱人是一个男人，也是他的挚友。他是住在田宫家隔壁的笹谷夫妇的丈夫。

宗春决心报仇，他认为简单的离婚只会给那个不忠的男人带来快乐。相反，他把目光投向了笹谷夫妇的妻子。

“不，停下来……放开我！”
“如果你一定要责怪某人，那就责怪你卑鄙的丈夫。”

等等，笹谷。我会让你体验一下珍贵的东西被夺走的痛苦！

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010280.html]DLsite[/url]]
